product_brief: SSL certificates with public keys generated using a Quantum Random Number Generator for enhanced security.
pqc_capability_description: The document describes the use of a Quantum Random Number Generator (QRNG) for entropy generation in SSL certificate keys, not Post-Quantum Cryptography algorithms. It states this is a "world first" for integrating QRNG into SSL certificates, but does not mention PQC algorithms like Kyber or Dilithium.
qrng_&_entropy_sources: Quantum Random Number Generator (QRNG) using a quantum computer acquired from Quandela; relies on laws of quantum physics for real, random numbers (entropy).
financial_&_business_impact: Included in all web hosting plans at no extra cost.

product_brief: Cloud storage service protecting business and individual data with post-quantum cryptography and zero-knowledge encryption.
pqc_capability_description: Internxt Drive has successfully implemented Kyber-512 post-quantum encryption, selected by NIST, to protect against quantum threats. It uses lattice-based cryptography. PQC is available for all Drive subscribers and is planned for upcoming Mail, Meet, VPN, and Antivirus products.
crypto_primitives: Kyber-512, AES-256, RSA (mentioned as vulnerable context)
key_management_model: Zero-knowledge policies; private key kept secret by user, public key shared.
architecture_type: Cloud storage (SaaS); zero-knowledge encrypted cloud storage directly on device.
primary_platforms: Cloud storage; runs on user device.
target_industries: Business, individual, financial, healthcare, governments, cloud storage.
pqc_roadmap_details: PQC is currently available for Internxt Drive. It will soon be included in upcoming Mail, Meet, VPN, and Antivirus products.

product_brief: Application-layer post-quantum cryptographic solution for scalable end-to-end user data protection using hybrid IES and envelope encryption.
pqc_capability_description: Production rollout of TikTok's first post-quantum cryptographic solution. Uses hybrid post-quantum IES combining NIST-standardized elliptic curve cryptography and MLKEM (FIPS 203). Supports post-quantum key formats in internal KMS. Currently deployed in business-critical scenarios, rolling out to all users. Monitoring post-quantum HPKE and X-Wing KEM for future adoption.
crypto_primitives: RSA, Elliptic Curve Cryptography (ECC), MLKEM (Module-Lattice-based Key Encapsulation Mechanism), AEAD, Diffie-Hellman Integrated Encryption Scheme (IES), Hybrid Public Key Encryption (HPKE)
key_management_model: Envelope encryption with centralized Key Management Service (KMS); unique Data Encryption Key (DEK) per device encrypted with Key Encryption Key (KEK); post-quantum key format support.
architecture_type: Application-layer crypto with centralized decryption service and envelope encryption
fips_validated: No (Uses NIST-standardized algorithms including FIPS 203 MLKEM, but no FIPS 140 validation status stated)
primary_platforms: User devices (mobile/web clients implied by "user devices" and "TikTok servers")
pqc_roadmap_details: Currently using hybrid post-quantum IES (ECC + MLKEM). Actively monitoring emerging standards such as post-quantum HPKE and may adopt hybrid KEM-based implementations like X-Wing KEM as they mature.
signature_schemes: Not stated (Document focuses on Key Encapsulation Mechanisms and Encryption; specific signature algorithms like ECDSA or Ed25519 are not explicitly listed as supported schemes, though ECC is mentioned for key exchange)
deployment_&_migration_complexity: Stateless, single-use DEK dispatch protocol allows simple updates without backward compatibility concerns.

product_brief: Russia's first quantum-resistant TLS gateway protecting network traffic from classical and quantum computer attacks.
pqc_capability_description: Pilot integration of PQC GATE software and PQC SDK into S-Terra's TLS Gateway. Provides quantum-stable TLS tunnel connections using post-quantum algorithms of domestic implementation. Tests confirmed compliance with information security requirements.
crypto_primitives: Post-quantum algorithms of domestic implementation (specific algorithm names not stated)
key_management_model: TLS-based connection management; uses PQC GATE for encrypted TCP tunnels. Specific key exchange mechanisms (e.g., IKE, PSK) not detailed.
architecture_type: Hardware and software package (TLS Gateway); client-server software (PQC GATE); library (PQC SDK).
regulatory_status: Resident of Skolkovo (VEB Group); pending adoption of relevant state standards for widespread introduction.
pqc_roadmap_details: Widespread introduction into Russian IT infrastructure planned after the adoption of relevant state standards.
testing_&_validation_methods: Comprehensive tests carried out in a limited perimeter of information systems; functional acceptance confirmed compliance with stated information security requirements.
